payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compress string to alternating bits, count zero blocks. If reverse cost < invert cost, output (blocks-1)*x + y (merge all zeros then invert), else output blocks*y (invert each block).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy decision based on comparing x and y. This is classic exchange argument: merging zero blocks with reverse before inverting is optimal when x < y, otherwise separate inversion is better. Directly implements that logic.
